source(output(
		SubscriberId as string,
		Gender as string,
		Member_Language as string,
		Member_Ethnic_Desc as string,
		MemberCity as string,
		MemberState as string,
		MemberCounty as string,
		PrimaryMemberPhone as string,
		HealthPlanName as string,
		PCP_ProviderName as string,
		MeasureName as string,
		CampaignName as string,
		FirstName as string,
		LastName as string,
		DateOfBirth as timestamp,
		MemberAddress1 as string,
		MemberZip as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @ENDDATE DATETIME DECLARE @STARTDATE DATETIME DECLARE @DUEDATESTARTDATE DATETIME DECLARE @DUEDATEENDDATE DATETIME DECLARE @AGESTARTDATE DATETIME  SET @ENDDATE = DATEADD(MONTH,0,DATEADD(DAY,-1,DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, getdate()), 0))) SET @STARTDATE = DATEADD(MONTH,-1,DATEADD(DAY,1,@ENDDATE)) SET @AGESTARTDATE = DATEADD(YEAR,-21,@ENDDATE)  SET @DUEDATEENDDATE = DATEADD(MONTH,0,DATEADD(DAY,-1,DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, getdate()), 0))) SET @DUEDATESTARTDATE = DATEADD(MONTH,-1,DATEADD(DAY,1,@DUEDATEENDDATE))  DECLARE @TMP1 TABLE (Member VARCHAR(15)) INSERT INTO @TMP1 (Member) SELECT Member  FROM EPSDTFollowup  WHERE ServiceType = \'EXAM\'  	AND Duedate BETWEEN @DUEDATESTARTDATE and @DUEDATEENDDATE GROUP BY Member 	 SELECT DISTINCT  	  CM.Member + \'\' AS \'SubscriberId\' 	, CM.FirstName + \'\' AS \'FirstName\' 	, CM.LastName + \'\' AS \'LastName\' 	, CM.SEX + \'\' AS \'Gender\' 	, CM.BirthDate + \'\' AS \'DateOfBirth\' 	, CM.Language + \'\' AS \'Member_Language\' 	, CM.Address1 + \'\' AS \'MemberAddress1\' 	, CM.Ethnicity + \'\' AS \'Member_Ethnic_Desc\' 	, CM.City + \'\' AS \'MemberCity\' 	, CM.State + \'\' AS \'MemberState\' 	, CM.Zip + \'\' AS \'MemberZip\' 	, CM.County + \'\' AS \'MemberCounty\' 	, CM.Phone + \'\' AS \'PrimaryMemberPhone\' 	, CM.Market + \'\' AS \'HealthPlanName\' 	, P.FullName + \'\' AS \'PCP_ProviderName\' 	, \'EXAM\' AS \'MeasureName\' 	, \'THSTEPS\' AS CampaignName FROM EPSDTCurrentMember CM INNER JOIN @TMP1 T ON CM.Member = T.Member AND CM.ProgNum IN (\'TS\',\'TX\')  AND CM.BirthDate BETWEEN @AGESTARTDATE and @ENDDATE AND DATEDIFF(mm,CONVERT(DATETIME,  CM.BirthDate ),GETDATE())>=0 INNER JOIN EPSDTProvider P ON CM.AffNum = P.AffNum ORDER BY [SubscriberId]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> EPSDTMPOSQuery	source(output(
		MEME_CK as string,
		GRGR_CK as string,
		MEPE_ELIG_IND as string,
		CSPI_ID as string,
		GroupCode as string,
		SubscriberId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'TRUNCATE TABLE [PDS_2008].[dbo].[MPOS_CSPI_ID_TX_TS] INSERT INTO [PDS_2008].[dbo].[MPOS_CSPI_ID_TX_TS] SELECT DISTINCT MEPE.MEME_CK, MEPE.GRGR_CK, MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND ,CSPI_ID,CASE WHEN GR.GRGR_CK=88 THEN GRGR_ID ELSE \'TXMCD000\' END AS GroupCode, SubscriberId = SBSB.SBSB_ID + \'00\'  FROM [ODW].[DW].[FAC_CMC_GRGR_GROUP] GR    INNER JOIN  ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE  ON GR.GRGR_CK=MEPE.GRGR_CK AND MEPE.GRGR_CK IN (4,88) INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEPE.MEME_CK= MEME.MEME_CK AND MEPE.GRGR_CK = MEME.GRGR_CK AND MEME.GRGR_CK IN (4,88) INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK AND  MEME.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND SBSB.GRGR_CK IN (4,88) WHERE GR.GRGR_CK IN (4,88) AND MEPE_ELIG_IND =\'Y\' AND MEPE_EFF_DT <= GETDATE () AND MEPE_TERM_DT >= GETDATE () AND CSPI_ID NOT IN (\'TXSCHIP0\',\'TXSCHIP1\',\'TXSCHIP2\',\'TXSCHIP3\',\'TXSCHIP4\',\'TXSCHIP5\',\'TXSCHIP9\',\'TXSCHP10\', \'TXSCHIP6\',\'TXSCHP11\',\'TXSCHP12\',\'TXSCHIP7\',\'TXSCHIP8\',\'TXSCHPT1\',\'TXSCHPT2\',\'TXCHIP00\',\'TXCHIP01\',\'TXCHIP02\',\'TXCHIP03\',\'TXCHIP04\',\'TXCHIP05\',\'TXCHIP09\',\'TXCHIP10\',\'TXCHIP06\', \'TXCHIP11\',\'TXCHIP12\',\'TXCHIP07\',\'TXCHIP08\',\'TXCHIPT1\',\'TXCHIPT2\')  SELECT DISTINCT MEME_CK,GRGR_CK,MEPE_ELIG_IND,CSPI_ID,GroupCode,SubscriberId FROM [PDS_2008].[dbo].[MPOS_CSPI_ID_TX_TS]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
EPSDTMPOSQuery sort(asc(SubscriberId, false)) ~> Sort1
OLEDBSource sort(asc(SubscriberId, false)) ~> Sort
Sort,Sort1 join(OLEDBSource@SubscriberId == EPSDTMPOSQuery@SubscriberId,
	joinType:'inner',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
